method: READ-ONLY network + file audit. No AutoCAD process started/attached; no packages installed; nothing executed from upstream. GitHub: `git ls-remote https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> HEAD` for the default-branch HEAD SHA (done with git 2.53.0); `git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --no-checkout` into a temp dir followed by `git ls-tree -r HEAD` for file presence and `git rev-parse HEAD:<path>` for file blob SHAs (this is why the blob SHAs below are authoritative); `curl -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>` , `.../releases/latest` , `.../contents/<LICENSE>?ref=<sha>` with the standard unauthenticated 60 req/h limit. LICENSE identity = first non-empty line of the file fetched at the pinned SHA, plus the git blob SHA; the SPDX-ish label is justified only from the text actually read (GitHub API spdx_id is recorded next to it but, like GitHub itself, reports NOASSERTION/null for hand-written multi-license files). NuGet: `curl --compressed https://api.nuget.org/v3/registration5-gz-semver2/<lowercase-id>/index.json` and, for paged ids, the linked `.../page/<lo>/<hi>.json`; package facts come from the real .nupkg downloaded from `https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/<id>/<version>/<id>.<version>.nupkg` and unzipped in memory (nuspec + LICENSE + lib/* TFMs). Local: `os.walk` over D:\CAD APPLOAD\ObjectARX\* for filename patterns and for a license-sentence regex inside text files; a scan for CJK code points over the U-C4N working tree. Single output dir: docs/evidence/P0/20260917T083402Z/raw/ ; JSON assembled with python 3.11 and written UTF-8 without BOM.

discovery_dictionary_question.question: Does U-C4N/Autocad-MCP ship an English+Chinese command dictionary for FILLET / round-corner?
discovery_dictionary_question.answer: NO. It ships an English-only AutoCAD-command/natural-language alias corpus. There is no Chinese dictionary and no CJK text anywhere in the repository.

discovery_dictionary_question.chinese_alias_consequence_for_project: CadBridge must build its own Chinese (and English) command alias dictionary; nothing Chinese can be reused from this source.

risk_review.evidence: nuspec <owners>Autodesk, Inc.</owners>; <authors>AutoCAD Team</authors>; license file inside nupkg is the Autodesk ObjectARX EULA; package contains the ObjectARX managed reference assemblies.
risk_review.not_a_third_party_repackaging: CORRECTED: the audit brief assumed a community repackage. The fetched nuspec/LICENSE show this is published by Autodesk, Inc. itself.
risk_review.license_file_in_package: LICENSE.txt (6473 bytes) == Autodesk ObjectARX EULA, blank first line, then "For ObjectARX(R) for AutoCAD(R) 2024, 2023, 2022, and 2021"
license_summary_verbatim_quotes: THIS IS A CONTRACT. BY INSTALLING THIS SOFTWARE YOU ACCEPT ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THIS AGREEMENT.

You may make unlimited copies of the Software and give copies to other persons or entities so long as (i) all such copies are used to develop applications for Autodesk products based on the AutoCAD(R) platform and excluding AutoCAD LT(R), DWG TrueConvert(TM), and DWG TrueView(TM) and (ii) all such copies contain this Agreement and the same copyright and other proprietary notices that appear on or in the Software.
You may not use the Software to develop applications for AutoCAD LT(R), DWG TrueConvert(TM), and DWG TrueView(TM) software
The structure, organization, and code of the Software are valuable trade secrets of Autodesk and its licensors and You shall keep such trade secrets confidential.
risk_review.redistribution_finding: The EULA grants unlimited copying of the ObjectARX SDK only for developing AutoCAD-platform applications, and requires every copy to carry the agreement and proprietary notices. It does NOT grant a general right to redistribute the SDK assemblies as part of a product; the installed package also sets CopyLocal=false for every managed assembly via tools/install.ps1.
files_contained_in_nupkg_26.0.0: plus matching .xml docs, LICENSE.txt, adsk.xml, tools/install.ps1
risk_review.files_not_contained: AcCoreMgd.dll is NOT in AutoCAD.NET 26.0.0 (it moved to AutoCAD.NET.Core 26.0.0); acdbmgdbrep.dll is not in the package either.
risk_review.target_framework_warning: AutoCAD.NET 26.0.0 (AutoCAD 2027) ships ONLY lib/net10.0. The local ObjectARX SDKs on this machine are 2014/2017/2018/2019/2021/2025 - no net10.0 match. Any net8.0/net48 plugin must bind to the matching AutoCAD.NET 25.x / 24.x line instead.
